_meta.description: Admin-managed LLM operation routing table. Edit this file to change which model handles which operation. This is the canonical location — do not hardcode model selections in agent skill files.

ops.description: Clio's first 3 turns with a new user — highest quality required
Clio introduces two users — requires nuanced, high-quality output
Sage facilitates a cluster arc phase transition
Sage intervenes in a cluster values conflict
Sage posts to cluster Pulse tab
Atlas generates conversation hook per content card
Atlas scores content relevance against AGGIL segment
Scout reads public internet signals and applies LLM inference to calibrate community patterns
Scout generates intelligence report for Clio based on observed signals + LLM inference
Compress USER.md interaction history after 90 days
Superior agent analyzes gaps and proposes tools for its subordinate agent — high reasoning task
ops._note: Used when: Sage proposes Atlas tools, Clio proposes Sage/Scout tools, Observer proposes Clio tools

ops.description: Lightweight structured pre-check — radical shift gate, scope preservation, PII scan
ops._note: Returns structured boolean + reason. Fast and cheap — must not block real-time flows.

ops.description: Agent Collaboration Chatbox — Clio+Sage exchange generation (dual-agent prompt)
ops._note: Generates both Sage's observation and Clio's response in a single structured call. Used by AgentChatboxExchange worker.

ops.description: Sage 48h feature intelligence evaluation — signal aggregation + disqualification check
ops._note: Runs every 48h per cluster. Evaluates accumulated feature signals against four disqualifying conditions.

ops.description: Sage response to @Sage mention — deduplication-aware, cluster-context-rich
ops._note: SLA: 30 seconds. Includes deduplication step (embedding similarity check) before generation.

ops.description: Sage bridge message when human response is delayed on an escalated thread
ops._note: Short, empathetic acknowledgement. Must never say 'the founder has been notified'. See SAGE_ANCHOR_PROTOCOL.md.
